name: skin-diseases
description: A mobile-friendly web application for skin disease detection and management

scripts.dev:remote: bash start_tunnels.sh && concurrently "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: bun run install:frontend && bun run install:backend
